title: tools/research и perf: frontmatter, summary, разбить большие
goal: Паспорта исследований tools/research/**/{README,summary}.md, docs/perf/*, REQUIREMENTS.md, TODO.md проходят docs check: frontmatter, summary ≤140, статус по коду main, ≤40 КБ.

accept.name: docs
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli docs check tools/research docs/perf REQUIREMENTS.md TODO.md 2>&1 | grep ОШИБКА | grep -v 'нет файла'; true

accept.name: only_md
accept.cmd: git diff --name-only feature/docs-rework...HEAD -- tools/research | grep -v -E '\.md$'; true
